summary: Parameters for ansible.builtin.sudo: become_exe (sudo), become_flags (-H -S -n), become_pass, become_user (root), and sudo_chdir (2.19+) to change directory before sudo.
questions: What flags does Ansible pass to sudo by default?
How do I change the sudo executable Ansible uses?
Who does Ansible become by default with sudo?
How do I avoid permission errors when becoming an unprivileged user with sudo?

answer_card.title: sudo become parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
| Option | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `become_exe` | `sudo` | sudo executable |
| `become_flags` | `-H -S -n` | options passed to sudo |
| `become_pass` | | sudo password |
| `become_user` | `root` | user to become |
| `sudo_chdir` | | (2.19+) directory to change to before sudo; avoids permission errors when dropping privileges |
